title: $R$-trivial Galois cohomology classes and cohomological $p$-dimension
summary: Given a prime $p$, a field $F$ of characteristic different from $p$ and a finite $p$-primary Galois module $V$, a Galois cohomology class in $H^n(F,V)$ is called $R$-trivial if it can be connected to $0$ by a class defined over an open subscheme of the projective line. All classes of $H^n(F,V)$ are $R$-trivial if $F$ has cohomological $p$-dimension at most $n$, by the Bloch-Kato conjecture.
